faq.q: What is the origin of Aicha?
faq.a: Aicha is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of عائشة. The source record's gloss 'Successor, Supporter' is unsupported.
Yes — the underlying form عائشة is Arabic.
Aicha can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Aicha should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. عائشة is not a Qur'anic form; it is the name of ʿĀʾisha bint Abī Bakr in the hadith and sīra tradition
